_comment: Consumer-side fixture for the crucible-evaluator -> crucible-dashboard contract on report_card['attestation'] (config-I6974, extended config-I7039). Shape mirrors crucible-evaluator grading/attestation.py::build_run_attestation exactly: schema/run_date/verdict/as_of/evaluator/backtester/evaluator_stage/promotion_withheld/reason, with each half carrying its own status/verdict/checks/n_checks/n_failed/n_errored/engine. THREE halves, not two: the Evaluator STAGE's verdict (the ranking metrics it grades and promotes on, run on the spot box) joined in crucible-evaluator#189 and the renderer must name it, or a PASS line understates what was checked while looking exactly as confident. `as_of` carries each upstream object's S3 LastModified so a stale verdict reads stale rather than green. Per-check bodies are truncated to one record per half - the renderer reads counts, as_of and reasons, never individual checks.

checks.name: sharpe_annualization
checks.description: sample-sd (ddof=1) Sharpe on the frozen series, x sqrt(252)

evaluator_stage.reason: evaluator stage attestation PASS (4 known-answer checks).

reason: All three halves attested - the deployed quant primitives, the backtest engine, and the Evaluator stage's ranking metrics each agreed with their hand-derived known answers.
